name: CableLAN Products
old_description: Welcome to CableLAN Products. We supply structured wiring products from today’s leading manufacturers. We have everything to install your network – cable, patch cords, jacks and outlets, patch panels, racks, cabinets, test equipment and installation accessories. Browse our on-line catalog and place your orders for fast, convenient shipping or pickup at one of our locations.
about:
CableLAN Products was founded in 1994 in Riverside, Rhode Island. The company began with a mission to provide outstanding service and value to data and telephone contractors in the Boston area. Ownership details and founders are not disclosed.

The company operates as a distributor of structured wiring products, including cable, patch cords, jacks, outlets, patch panels, racks, cabinets, test equipment, and installation accessories. It also supplies fiber optic assemblies and electrical communication cables. In 1997, a branch opened in Warwick, Rhode Island, expanding service to Rhode Island and southeastern Massachusetts. CableLAN describes itself as the largest regional distributor in New England and the largest stocking distributor of structured network products in Rhode Island. It also serves as a worldwide supplier of fiber optic and electrical communication cables to nuclear power plants.

Primary customers include data and telephone contractors in the New England region, as well as nuclear power generation facilities globally. The company’s product range supports structured cabling installations for commercial and industrial networks.

CableLAN emphasizes total value through great service, top-quality products, and competitive pricing. Long-standing relationships with premier manufacturing partners, many dating back to the company’s start, underpin its ability to maintain a broad inventory and respond to evolving market needs.
